section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the factor analysis of the Portuguese Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) with 13 items conducted on a sample of 310-311 participants. The analysis extracted two factors: General body appreciation (10 items, α = .89) and Body image investment (α = .67). Men showed significantly higher General body appreciation than women (M = 4.11 vs. M = 3.90, p = .005), but no significant gender difference was found in Body image investment scores. Due to the low alpha coefficient of the Body image investment factor, only the General body appreciation factor was retained for further analyses.
